svg.title: Plasma light above the channel, beside a same-scale ion cannon
svg.desc: Five expected zoom rows, each with one production ion cannon and three hard-light profiles. The physical channel is 1.6 world units wide. The hot core is 2 world units wide and is painted above the equipment, overlapping both channel edges. At 2 times this is a 2 CSS pixel core over a 1.6 CSS pixel channel. All drawings have labelled CSS sizes and use Planet Inspector zooms.
